name: relay
description: Export bounded repository work to ChatGPT and safely stage returned results for local validation and review.

interface.longDescription: Package the exact repository context for a bounded work unit into one self-contained Task Capsule, then inspect, drift-check, stage, and locally validate a Result Capsule returned from ChatGPT in an isolated Git worktree without modifying your active branch.
defaultPrompt: Use plan-chatgpt to split this feature into exportable units
Export this bounded task to ChatGPT
Import this ChatGPT Result Capsule and review it
